caption: The drawing depicts a wooden tilt-top table with a circular tabletop. The wood appears to be a reddish-brown color, possibly mahogany or a similar type, with visible wood grain texture. The tabletop is shown in a vertical, upright position, exposing the underside, which reveals supporting wooden braces and a squared frame attached to the pedestal. The pedestal is turned, cylindrical, and connects to three outwardly curving legs that form a tripod base. The legs are also constructed of matching reddish-brown wood. The table is centered on a plain, light beige background. A faint rectangular border frames the entire drawing, and handwritten text beneath the table reads: "Height closed 30" - Table Top 30" Wide."
title: Table (Collapsible)
